segments.text: Bottom line: pilot Copilot Code for one small purpose-built solution, with IT policy set first, a named owner, scoped data, a spend limit and an explicit stop-or-expand review.

Code is for outcome-led builders, not a replacement for developer tools. Describe a dashboard, team tool, site, transform, automation or script; Code builds a live preview, keeps revertible versions and can publish cloud apps to Copilot Managed Runtime for your organization.

Local mode works inside a chosen folder and asks approval by default for network, extensions or MCP, shell commands and outside-folder access. Cloud mode is isolated. Microsoft says existing Microsoft 365 governance applies, with audit visibility into code, commands and file activity.

IT must confirm license and enablement, then set auto-approve, execution location, GitHub, organizational data and spend policies. Recommendation: one low-risk business use case, one owner, least data needed, a budget cap, and a stop-or-expand review before broader access.
